category_edits.rationale: Add a bounded, parameter-free repeat feature: scale each nonpadding input embedding by 1 + 0.1 * min(log(1+c), log(4)) / log(4), where c counts earlier occurrences in the available input sequence. Counts are causal and computed identically during training and prediction. Preserve embedding tables, GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer, and per-category checkpoints. The generated predictor already imports this model class.
